description: This json file contains the corrections for the deepJet, robustParticleTransformer, particleNet AK4 jet taggers for the 2022_Summer22 campaign.  Corrections are supplied for c-tagging working point corrections (wp). Working points for the tagging algorithms are also supplied in this file (wp_values).

corrections.name: deepJet_wp_values
corrections.description: Working points values of the c-jet discrimination for deepJet in 2022_Summer22. Important: the two axes 'CvB' and 'CvL' are to be used together, e.g. a loose working point is defined as a simultaneous cut on both values.

output.name: wp
output.description: Working point value of the CvL or CvB discriminator

corrections.name: robustParticleTransformer_wp_values
corrections.description: Working points values of the c-jet discrimination for robustParticleTransformer in 2022_Summer22. Important: the two axes 'CvB' and 'CvL' are to be used together, e.g. a loose working point is defined as a simultaneous cut on both values.

output.name: wp
output.description: Working point value of the CvL or CvB discriminator

corrections.name: particleNet_wp_values
corrections.description: Working points values of the c-jet discrimination for particleNet in 2022_Summer22. Important: the two axes 'CvB' and 'CvL' are to be used together, e.g. a loose working point is defined as a simultaneous cut on both values.

output.name: wp
output.description: Working point value of the CvL or CvB discriminator

corrections.name: deepJet_light
corrections.description: Scale factors for light (udsg) jets. For the working point correction multiple different uncertainty schemes are provided. 'up/down_correlated' (systematic uncertainty) and 'up/down_uncorrelated' (statistical uncertainty) scale factor variations are provided, which are supposed to be correlated/decorrelated between the different data years. If only one year is analyzed and the tagging uncertainty impact is small the simplified 'up' and 'down' systematics can be used, but is generally not recommended.

inputs.name: systematic
inputs.description: 'central' for nominal SF. 'up/down' for total SF variation. 'up/down_correlated/uncorrelated' for syst/stat uncertainty.

corrections.name: deepJet_wc
corrections.description: Working point based c-tagging scale factors for charm jets from W+c events. Uncertainties are split into syst and stat. They are to be correlated and decorrelated between different eras, respectively.

inputs.name: systematic
inputs.description: 'central' for nominal SF. 'up/down_syst/stat' for syst/stat uncertainty.

corrections.name: deepJet_tnp
corrections.description: Working point based c-tagging scale factors for b jets from emu ttbar events. Uncertainties are split into multiple components. These sources consist of 'up/down_pdf/colorreconnection/mescales/hdamp/tune/jer/bdecay/pileup/bkg/topmass/psscale/jes/statistic'. All of the sources can be correlated between the years, except the 'statistic' source which is to be decorrelated between the years. If only one year is analyzed and the tagging uncertainty impact is small the simplified 'up' and 'down' systematics can be used, but is generally not recommended.

inputs.name: systematic
inputs.description: 'central' for nominal SF. 'up/down' for total SF variation. Other 'up/down_X' for additional uncertainty breakdown.
